accessType.description: How the server is exposed. 'ingress' creates a cloudflare-tunnel ingress at <name>-mc.<domain>; 'loadbalancer' / 'nodeport' expose the service directly on port 25565.

domain.description: Base domain used for the ingress host <name>-mc.<domain>. Only used when accessType is 'ingress'.

diskSpace.description: Amount of disk space to allocate to the server in gigibytes (Gi) (1Gi = 1024Mi)

modrinthProjects.description: List of modrinth project short names (Example - from https://modrinth.com/mod/pixelmon the short name is pixelmon)

spigotPluginIds.description: List of spigot resource ids (Example - from https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/luckperms.28140 the resource id is 28140) (default plugins: Chunky, ChunkyBorder, LuckPerms, and Vault)

storageClass.description: Storage class to use for PVC

worldUrl.description: URL to download the world from, must be a direct link to a zip archive
